overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that Husband-Wife relationship dynamics ('पति-पत्नी' and 'Shaadi Ke Baad') significantly outperform other topics, driving top-tier views (1,600+), whereas poetry/shayari ('शायरी') and niche topics underperform. However, due to the limited sample size across diverse categories, overall confidence is moderate and relies on a clear emerging winner.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,666 views) and 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,619 views) dramatically outperformed family, parent, and poetry shorts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on married life realities, unsaid expectations, and emotional distance in long-term relationships.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 6 views, showing poor pull in short-form feed without a concrete visual or situational hook.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic titles and focus on concrete everyday situations rather than generalized heartbreak.
